scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check-build.js
scripts.package: npm run check && (archive="newtab-studio-$npm_package_version.zip" && temp=$(mktemp .newtab-studio-package.XXXXXX) && trap 'rm -f "$temp"' 0 && (cd dist && zip -qr - .) > "$temp" && unzip -tq "$temp" && mv -f "$temp" "$archive" && echo "Created $archive")
